If your feed has been hijacked by a scary Yakuza boss losing his mind over a birthday banner, I get it “I feel the same”. So, why am I baby mafia  anime everywhere right now?

Let me explain it to you.

What Is Why Am I Baby Mafia Anime?

It’s a vertical, AI-animated short series and a spin-off of Why Can I Summon: Death. The plot: a lethal Yakuza boss suddenly has to raise a six-year-old girl, “Lady Liza,” and treats parenting like a tactical operation. Hitmen throw tea parties.

A whole crime syndicate bows to a kindergartener. It’s ridiculous, and that’s the point.

Why Am I Baby Mafia Anime Where to Watch

Discover more
Custom anime avatars
Anime voice acting
Anime character portraits

Here’s the thing that trips people up: it’s not on Crunchyroll, Netflix, or Funimation. This isn’t a traditional studio production.

TV Shows & Programs

You’ll find it on Trimz.tv (also on iOS/Android) and scattered across YouTube Shorts and Instagram reels, with 30+ short episodes released so far.

My Honest Review

What works: The gag never gets old, hardened criminals doing daycare runs is genuinely funny, and each episode is under a minute, perfect for a quick laugh between tasks. I showed it to a non-anime friend and she was hooked in three episodes.

What doesn’t: No deep plot, thin  animation compared to studio work, and the AI-generated art has that slightly “off” uncanny quality if you look closely.
